agent.title: Agent
agent.description: AI agent CLI to use for the eval run.

model.title: Model
model.description: Specific LLM model to use. If empty, the agent uses its default model.

scenario.title: Testing Scenario
scenario.description: Markdown file with test scenario (YAML frontmatter + ## Test / ## Checkpoint / ## Monitor sections separated by ---).

systemPrompt.title: System Prompt
systemPrompt.description: Instructions sent to the agent at the start of each test. Used to configure agent behavior.

maxBudgetUsd.title: Max Budget (USD)
maxBudgetUsd.description: Maximum spend in USD for the entire run. If exceeded, the run is aborted. Uses claude --max-budget-usd.

maxRetries.title: Max Retries on Failure
maxRetries.description: If a checkpoint fails, retry the test this many times before marking as failed. 0 = no retries.

maxTurns.title: Max Turns per Test
maxTurns.description: Maximum number of agent turns per test step. Limits agent runtime.

envVariables.title: Environment Variables
envVariables.description: JSON object with API keys and secrets. Available to the agent and init script. Automatically masked in conversation logs.

initPreset.title: Init Script Preset
initPreset.description: Pre-defined environment setup. Applied before custom init script.

initBashScript.title: Custom Init Script
initBashScript.description: Bash script to set up the environment (install tools, configure MCP, etc.). Runs after the preset.

mcpConfigJson.title: MCP Config JSON
mcpConfigJson.description: MCP server configuration (passed to claude --mcp-config). Only used with mcp_native or mcpc presets.
